author: Quaternius

reasons: Exact creator-distribution glTF is a compact single-skinned-mesh actor compatible with the existing review renderer direction
Flying_Idle and Fast_Flying provide authored locomotion vocabulary for visual review
HitReact and Death cover baseline combat lifecycle presentation
Headbutt and Punch can be reviewed as source motion vocabulary without changing the established Scout ranged-pressure gameplay role
constraints: Winged source presentation does not authorize flight gameplay; preserve the established Scout ranged-pressure semantics until field evidence supports a deliberate gameplay change
No authored walk/run clip exists, so grounded proxy locomotion must not be silently mapped to a misleading production animation
Source-space geometry begins above Y=1.18; Minecraft field review must establish root transform, ground alignment, player-relative scale, facing and hitbox
Source Atlas material is CC0 source presentation; final Region 01 art/material acceptance remains human-gated
Do not replace the natural Scout proxy until an isolated field-review actor is build-verified and human role/readability review accepts it

inspection_method: Exact creator-distribution bytes downloaded from the public Quaternius Ultimate Monsters Google Drive folder and parsed locally; counts/bounds/animation durations are derived from glTF accessors and animation sampler inputs.
